title: Append Field
prompt: A React dynamic form adds another field without mutating state. Write a helper that returns a new array with the new value appended to the existing fields.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Append Field, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A React dynamic form adds another field without mutating state. Write a helper that returns a new array with the new value appended to the existing fields. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in React using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
